description: This file defines a mock class 'MediaPipelineIpcFactoryMock' for unit testing, which inherits from 'IMediaPipelineIpcFactory' and mocks the 'createMediaPipelineIpc' method. It is part of the 'firebolt::rialto::client' namespace and includes dependencies on 'IMediaPipelineIpc.h' and Google Mock.

classes.name: MediaPipelineIpcFactoryMock
classes.description: A mock class for 'IMediaPipelineIpcFactory' used in unit testing to simulate creation of media pipeline IPC objects.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineIpc
methods.description: Mocked method to create a media pipeline IPC object, taking a client pointer and video requirements as parameters.
